items.title: Article: When Spec-Driven Development Pays Off
items.summary: AI coding assistants have become a core part of software development. AI-generated code has shown productivity gains, but it's also contributing to security weaknesses and familiar bug patterns. In this article, author Nitin Garg highlights the bottleneck has moved from code generation to code verification, and how to detect & mitigate it when the AI-generated behavior diverges from the intent. By Nitin Garg

items.title: IETF Publishes RFC 10008, Adding the QUERY Method for Safe Requests With a Body
items.summary: In June 2026, the IETF published RFC 10008, introducing the QUERY method to HTTP, the first new standard HTTP verb since 2010. QUERY enables developers to send richer query filters in the request body while maintaining cacheable, safe, and idempotent semantics. This addition addresses long-standing limitations with GET and POST methods, facilitating improved API interactions. By Daniel Curtis

items.title: Digitaler Omnibus: Neues Bündnis will das Ende der Cookie-Banner einläuten

(Symbolbild) – Alle Rechte vorbehalten: IMAGO / Pond5 Images Mit ihrem Digitalen Omnibus will die EU-Kommission vor allem der Wirtschaft das Leben versüßen. Zu einem ihrer Vorschläge zählt jedoch auch, die vermaledeiten Cookie-Banner weitgehend aus der Welt zu schaffen. Dagegen läuft die Werbewirtschaft Sturm und bekommt nun ihrerseits Gegenwind zu spüren.
